portal_refresh_wrapper_not_read_only: Portal wrapper adds local_ip/rpi_id and publishes them; bypass it for this read-only request.

response.ok: submission accepted, not a proof of fresh RID
response.rs485_ident: old cache is returned immediately while daemon refresh thread runs

completion.require: map.updated_at advanced AND each selected row host_updated_at advanced; require current authoritative presence/recent/node identity flags independently
completion.partial_read_limitation: Non-authoritative merge preserves older peer rows; global updated_at alone does not prove peer refresh.

wire_read.owner: existing Core-owned stream; never open second USB handle
wire_read.lock: nonblocking identity poll lock prevents overlapping identity scans; shared EP0 RLock serializes control requests
wire_read.timing_limit: Shared EP0 lock acquisition has no own deadline;250ms is transfer timeout, not total completion SLA.

periodic_proposal.trigger: selected peer or local row missing/stale, not only map updated_at
periodic_proposal.node_ids: only current known2/7 cohort; never fallback to all32 selectors
periodic_proposal.failure: leave cohort/majority conservatively unavailable; do not clear failure using ok/refresh_started or stale cached row
periodic_proposal.writes: no settings commands or request_scan, no Core/STM restart

limitation: USB module source fingerprint is captured from matching local bundle; a separate fresh runtime module hash was not supplied. Exact active Core command support is confirmed by runtime Core SHA.
